subject: Security kickoff & questionnaire preference — NeuroTech Labs
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Aaron Klein <aaron.k@neurotechlabs.com>, Priya Suresh <priya.s@neurotechlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Intro + security kickoff for NeuroTech Labs — SIG/BAA questions

Hi Aaron & Priya,

Thanks again for the time on today’s discovery call — great context on the integration and the PHI scope you described. Per our discussion I wanted to kick off the security/questionnaire track and propose next steps so we can scope evidence and timelines.

Short recap / asks:
- Confirm SOC 2 posture (type & last audit date) and whether a redacted report is available.
- You mentioned PHI — please confirm that a signed BAA will be required. If so, do you prefer DocuSign for execution?
- Data residency: you said EU customers require EU-only processing. Can you confirm whether that means EU-only hosting (cloud regions) or strictly on-prem/VPC options?
- Questionnaire preference: do you want us to start with the SIG Lite, full CAIQ, or a custom prefill? We can do a prefill in whichever format speeds your intake.

Attachments: I’ve attached a short prefill spreadsheet that maps our standard answers (neurotech_sig_prefill.xlsx) and a link to our sample BAA (sample_baa_docusign.link). If you have a preferred evidence format (PDF export from your portal, screenshots, console exports), tell us and we’ll match it.

Proposed schedule:
1) You confirm the items above by EOD Tue (31 Aug).
2) We return a first-pass prefill (SIG or CAIQ) by Thu 2 Sep and collect evidence requests.
3) Evidence handoff by 7 Sep; 30-min follow-up call week of 6 Sep to review.

If the SIG vs CAIQ choice is unclear, tell us which fields you care most about (e.g., encryption, data residency, BAA) and we’ll prioritize those.

Thanks — looping Marissa (CS) and Karthik (security) to help with the evidence mapping.

Best,
Jordan
Jordan Blake | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0187

Attachments: neurotech_sig_prefill.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), sample_baa_docusign.link (DocuSign URL stub)
From: Aaron Klein <aaron.k@neurotechlabs.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@neurotechlabs.com
Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2027 11:03:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Intro + security kickoff for NeuroTech Labs — SIG/BAA questions

Jordan — thanks for the clear recap. Answers inline below.

- SOC 2: We completed SOC 2 Type II on 2026-11-15. We can provide a redacted report (redacted for customer sharing). Attaching the redacted PDF here (neurotech_soc2_2026_redacted.pdf).
- BAA: Yes — we process PHI for several pilot customers, so a BAA is required. DocuSign is fine.
- Data residency: We need EU-only processing for EU customer data. For some customers that means our production tenant is provisioned in eu-west-1; for stricter customers we can enable a dedicated VPC in the EU. We don’t require full on-prem for this engagement but we do need EU region guarantees and logging residency.
- Questionnaire: We typically prefer CAIQ because our vendor team maps it directly into their risk system. SIG Lite is acceptable if you provide a clear evidence map.

A couple of additional items for your security team:
- Key management: Do you support customer-managed keys (AWS KMS) or HSM integration?
- Encryption: AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.2+ in transit — can you confirm specifics about disk and DB encryption?
- Logging: We need API audit logs preserved for 12 months and accessible for export.

We can review the prefill you shared; I’ll route internally to security@neurotechlabs.com and Priya will coordinate the BAA signature.

Thanks,
Aaron Klein
Head of Platform Integrations | NeuroTech Labs
aaron.k@neurotechlabs.com | +44 20 7946 0991

Attachment: neurotech_soc2_2026_redacted.pdf (PDF stub)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Aaron Klein <aaron.k@neurotechlabs.com>, Priya Suresh <priya.s@neurotechlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 01 Sep 2027 08:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + security kickoff for NeuroTech Labs — SIG/BAA questions

Aaron — really helpful, thanks. Quick answers and next steps from our side: 

- KMS/HSM: Redwood supports customer-managed keys in Dedicated and Private modes; for Hosted we offer envelope encryption with customer-provided KMS keys in select regions. I’ll have Karthik add a short note on options by EOD.
- Disk/DB encryption: our standard offering uses full-disk encryption at the VM level and AES-256 for block storage; DBs use platform-managed encryption with optional CMKs. We’ll include exact cipher details in the evidence bundle.
- Audit logs: we support API audit logging with 12+ month retention in Dedicated/Private; for Hosted we can provide 12-month exports on request (we’ll capture the export format you prefer).

I’ve attached a short note that explains EU residency options we discussed (redwood_eu-residency-options.pdf) and re-uploaded the prefill to the shared Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/neurotech-prefill-2027.

Confirming the proposed follow-up: can we do Thu 9 Sep at 10:00 UTC for a 30-min alignment call? Please include any additional technical stakeholders (network/security owner). We’ll come prepared with a SIG vs CAIQ recommendation and an evidence checklist.

Best,
Jordan

Attachments: redwood_eu-residency-options.pdf (PDF stub)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aaron Klein <aaron.k@neurotechlabs.com>, Priya Suresh <priya.s@neurotechlabs.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Sep 2027 13:44:00 +05:30
Subject: Re: Security kickoff & questionnaire preference — clarifying technical requests

Thanks — a few clarifying items from security so we can produce a clean evidence pack: 

1) SOC2 scope: please confirm which systems were in scope for your 2026 Type II report (auth, ingestion pipeline, model hosting, analytics). We need a short inventory of included services and any excluded sub-service organizations.
2) Evidence format: PDFs and portal export CSVs are ideal; screenshots (annotated) are acceptable for console-only items. If you have automated exports for access logs (S3/ELK), please send a sample export.
3) Penetration test: do you have a recent external pentest report? If not, provide compensating controls (WAF, runtime protections) and a timeline for scheduled tests.
4) Retention & deletion: confirm data retention policy for customer data and deletion process for deprovisioned tenants.

If you can answer inline, we’ll map these to the CAIQ fields and flag any potential gaps.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Security Lead, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
From: Priya Suresh <priya.s@neurotechlabs.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aaron Klein <aaron.k@neurotechlabs.com>, security@neurotechlabs.com
Date: Fri, 03 Sep 2027 09:42:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Security kickoff & questionnaire preference — clarifying technical requests

Hi Jordan/Karthik — thanks for the details. Quick responses from our side: 

- SOC2 scope: covers auth, ingestion, model hosting, and analytics as Aaron noted. We’ll export the SOC2 cover letter that lists the in-scope systems.
- Evidence format: PDFs and console/export CSVs work best. We can do annotated screenshots where export is not possible.
- Pen test: our last external test was in 2025 and a new engagement is scheduled for Oct 2027; we can provide interim vulnerability scans and our remediation tracker.
- Retention & deletion: standard retention is 13 months for audit data; customer-controlled data retention can be configured per tenant — we’ll provide the retention policy document.

We’re happy with the proposed timeline and Thu 9 Sep 10:00 UTC works for our team. I’ll circulate attendee names (network/security owner) before the call and coordinate the BAA signature once you send the DocuSign.

Regards,
Priya Suresh
Director, Platform Security Operations | NeuroTech Labs
priya.s@neurotechlabs.com | +44 20 7946 0123
